abstract: Maintains electrical feeder capacity and physical hall floor areas
system_message:
You are Facility engineer (ENG). The Facility engineer (ENG) maintains electrical feeder capacity, physical hall floor areas, and climate control operational monitoring for candidate convention centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Climate control（HVAC）
information_points.content:
ENG-HVAC-ZB9：Operational HVAC logbooks record a chilled air exchange volume of 18,000 m3/h delivered under full occupancy for Meridian Waterfront Expo Center.
ENG-HVAC-YGL：The mechanical ventilation plant at Highland Summit Exhibition Hall delivers a chilled air exchange volume of 30,000 m3/h under full occupancy conditions.
ENG-HVAC-JRO：Continuous mechanical ventilation logs for Starlight Gateway Convention Complex show a chilled air exchange volume of 24,000 m3/h under full occupancy.

information_points.title: Maintains electrical feeder capacity and physical hall floor areas（POWER）
information_points.content:
ENG-POWER-T53：For Starlight Gateway Convention Complex, the main exhibition hall distribution feeder provides a certified electrical grid load capacity of 400 kW, and the net billable exhibit hall space spans 7,500 m2 according to the official cadastre.
ENG-POWER-GMA：Highland Summit Exhibition Hall maintains a certified electrical grid load capacity of 250 kW on its main exhibition hall distribution feeder based on substation verification testing, with a billable exhibit hall space of 4,500 m2 recorded in the floor plan cadastre.
ENG-POWER-8YV：For Meridian Waterfront Expo Center, the substation load verification test confirms a certified electrical grid load capacity of 320 kW along the main exhibition hall distribution feeder. According to the venue floor plan cadastre, the net billable exhibit hall space is 7,500 m2.
